description: We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation facility in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader dedicated to providing exceptional patient care and fostering a positive work environment.The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards, and driving continuous improvement in quality of care and operational efficiency. This role offers a chance to make a significant impact within a supportive and dynamic healthcare setting.Join a team committed to excellence and innovation in long-term care. We are looking for a leader who can inspire staff, engage with residents and their families, and uphold the highest standards of clinical and administrative practice.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated leadership, financial management, and operational oversight skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
